leo-docs: FYI my docs PR (refs: #427) tripped the docs CI: build error about duplicate anchors and a couple of images 404ing on CI only. Anyone seen weird anchor normalization lately? ci-bot: ci-bot: docs-site build failed: Error: duplicate id "quickstart" at /docs/quickstart.md:42 maya-frontend: We had a similar problem last month where emoji-prefixed headings and plain text collapse to the same slug. Docusaurus slugify depends on your config and the underlying slugger. leo-docs: I can repro the duplicate id locally if I run `yarn workspace docs build` inside a linux container. On mac it's fine which is confusing. ash-infra: The CI runner uses an Alpine image with different node/unicode behavior; plus the build step follows the pipeline config where we don't copy symlink targets in `docs/static/`. If images were symlinked to `../shared-assets/` they won't resolve on CI. tara-qa: Linkcheck output: `linkcheck: 4 broken links, missing images: /static/img/diagram.png, /static/img/arch.svg`. Those come from symlinked files in the monorepo. maya-frontend: Quick mitigation for anchors: add explicit id to the heading that conflicts. e.g. `

🚀 Quickstart

` — small and safe. Long term we should make slugify deterministic: `slugify: (s) => require('github-slugger').slug(s)` in docusaurus config. ash-infra: For the symlinks we have two options: (A) vendor copy the images into `docs/static/img/` in the PR, or (B) change CI to follow symlinks during the docs build: add `rsync -aL docs/static/ build/static/` or set `--copy-links` when copying. I prefer changing CI to avoid duplication, but vendoring is fastest for a single PR. leo-docs: I'll vendor-copy the two missing images into `docs/static/img/` for this PR to unblock. I'll also add a note in frontmatter mentioning the source of the diagrams. maya-frontend: I'll open a tiny PR to the docs config to use GitHub slugger so README anchors and docs match. That will reduce surprises. tara-qa: If we vendor-copy, add a checksum test in `docs/tests` so we detect drift if folks forget to update the copied files. I can add `yarn docs:linkcheck` to the local test script. ash-infra: I'll update the GitHub Actions workflow to run `yarn docs:linkcheck` and a `remark-unique-headers` rule. Also will enhance the failure message to print the exact heading lines and file so authors can fix quickly. maya-frontend: Another small UX thing: add a CONTRIBUTING.md snippet: "docs/static should not contain symlinks; prefer referencing shared assets via path or vendor-copying." leo-docs: Sounds good. Plan: I will (1) push a patch that replaces the two symlinked images with copies in `docs/static/img/`, (2) add explicit id for the conflicting heading in quickstart.md, and (3) update frontmatter to point to original source. Will ping once CI runs. tara-qa: Ping me when CI runs, I'll run the linkcheck locally too and validate. :+1: maya-frontend: Thanks! happy to land the slug config change after you confirm it doesn't change other anchors unexpectedly. leo-docs: Thanks everyone, opening PR now.
